U.S. MARINE CORPS MOS 6048

6048 Flight Equipment Technician

ASVAB score requirements, what the job involves, and how to raise the scores that count

Minimum ASVAB score

  • MM 105

Minimum AFQT

31

What a 6048 Does

Flight Equipment Technicians inspect, pack and repair the gear that keeps aircrews alive, including parachutes, survival kits and oxygen equipment. Because some of this equipment contains explosive devices, you must meet explosives handling standards. Careful, detail-focused work here directly protects pilots and aircrew.

Scores That Count for 6048

  • MM (Mechanical Maintenance) = AR + MC + EI + AS. Study: Arithmetic Reasoning, Mechanical Comprehension, Electronics Information, Auto and Shop

Marine Corps line scores average 100, and most people score between 60 and 140. Marine GT adds Mechanical Comprehension, so it is calculated differently from Army GT.

Other Requirements

  • Must meet explosives handler medical standards
  • Normal color vision

Related Marine Corps Jobs

  • 6531 Aircraft Ordnance Technician GT 105
  • 0481 Landing Support Specialist GT 95 and MM 100
  • 1371 Combat Engineer MM 95
  • 3521 Automotive Maintenance Technician MM 95
  • 3531 Motor Vehicle Operator MM 85
